AIS 165.finalExam: Taken only by students who earn a D or F on the written assignments or who do not complete all the assignments.
AIS 165.attendance: Required to attend all classes and arrive on time; more than one absence (except illness with a doctor's note) takes 1% off the class participation percentage.
AIS 165.lateWork: Late assignments lose 1% per day, weekends included, counted from the due date; any extension must be requested in writing before the due date.
other: No exams in the course; grade is built from 8 written assignments, field research and participation.
Rewrites may be requested on any assignment that does not meet the standard.
